evals.name: streamforge-ko
evals.prompt: 우리 팀 서버리스 실시간 분석 플랫폼 'StreamForge' 온라인 브로셔를 만들어줘. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda + DynamoDB + QuickSight 기반이고, 핵심 메시지는 '코드 없이 실시간 인사이트'. 핵심 지표는 처리량 200만 events/sec, 지연 <2초, 관리형 100%. 모바일·태블릿·PC 모두 잘 보여야 하고 아키텍처도 보이게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained responsive HTML brochure (mobile/tablet/PC) with hero/core message, value, feature grid, an embedded architecture diagram, CTA, accessibility primitives.
assertions: Architecture diagram embedded as SVG (inline )
Call-to-action present (demo / GitHub / contact button or link)
Self-contained: CSS inlined in <style> (no build step)

evals.name: trimcloud-en
evals.prompt: make a one-page landing page for our AWS cost-optimization SaaS called TrimCloud — hero with the tagline 'cut your AWS bill, not your workloads', 3 value props, a feature grid, an architecture diagram (it uses Cost Explorer API + Lambda + a React dashboard on S3/CloudFront), and a 'Request a demo' CTA. it has to look good on phones too.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained responsive HTML landing page (mobile/tablet/PC), hero+tagline, 3 value props, feature grid, embedded architecture diagram, demo CTA, accessibility primitives.
assertions: Architecture diagram embedded as SVG (inline )
Call-to-action present (demo / GitHub / contact button or link)
Self-contained: CSS inlined in <style> (no build step)
